summary: Claimed the free Jose V11 browser-verification job through the atomic G000001 portfolio pin and exercised a real Chromium 144 runtime over CDP. The browser environment replaced the public GitHub Pages candidate with an organization-policy block page before the wrapper JavaScript could execute. Control navigations to api.github.com and even 127.0.0.1 were blocked identically, so the failure is bounded to this worker's browser environment rather than attributed to the candidate. Static re-read still confirms the immutable 69,235-byte/SHA-256 gate and V11 source identity. Runtime VERIFIED, four-topic flow, wheel/grab-drag, and R07 eraser/undo interactions are deliberately not claimed.
